detailed_results.response:

* Since this is an international flight, online check-in will be available 24 hours before departure and will close 2 hours before departure.
* For baggage, 
  * Economy class passengers are allowed 1 carry-on bag (7kg max, 22x14x9 inches) and 1 personal item, with a checked baggage allowance of 23kg (50 lbs) included.
  * Business class passengers are allowed 2 carry-on bags (14kg total max) and 1 personal item, with a checked baggage allowance of 32kg (70 lbs) included.
* If you need to make any changes to your flight, please be aware that there will be a $100 fee if the change is made within 24 hours of departure, unless you are a business class passenger, in which case changes are free.
* For cancellations, 
  * If you cancel within 24 hours of booking, you will receive a full refund.
  * If you have a refundable ticket and cancel after 24 hours, there will be a $200 fee.
  * If you have a non-refundable ticket, you will receive a travel credit for 12 months.
* Meal service will be available on this flight since it is over 2 hours long. You can also request special meals (vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free) 24 hours in advance.
* Wi-Fi will be available for $10 (1 hour) or $20 (full flight).

For specific details on booking and fares, please call 1-800-SKYJET.
